name: femenu-quit
purpose: REPRODUCER of the QUIT GAME soft-lock (2026-09-30: failed at fe-reloaded, rolls settings_fix/quit_on1..v6; ENGINE_MAP 'A ScrPressStart reloaded ... never reaches InitGui'; fixed offline in a1f76ae/cbd8f92 - the .const renumbering). iter-463 settings review finding 4: QUIT GAME back to the front end with the custom_frontend mod ON (-Gates SR_MODS=custom_frontend). Title -> START -> MAIN MENU (claim) -> A = NEW GAME -> main_hud -> in game: START = pause menu (pulsed every 10 s for up to 3 min until the pause screen's own [APT_SCREEN] request appears: the scripted opening ignores START, roll renum_live/quit_renum2) -> UP (the wrap) = QUIT GAME -> A -> the QUIT GAME popup (lane E L-c: QUIT TO TITLE, the default / QUIT TO DESKTOP; its fresh [APT_SCREEN] request) -> A = QUIT TO TITLE -> StateAdapter.QuitGame -> the game's own return to the front end -> ScrPressStart reloads: its InitGui must run (the mod's Install logs 'install' with the OLD popup id still at saveFlow+16, unlike the first boot's 0) -> START -> the mod claims the re-raised LOAD A GAME? popup -> EXIT -> YES -> exit code 0. The A/B with the mod off is natural_quit.json. -TimeoutSeconds 600.

steps.name: pause
steps.purpose: START until the pause menu's own screen request appears (the scripted opening ignores START; quit_renum2). A pulse only repeats while the marker is absent, so an open pause menu is never toggled shut.

steps.name: up-to-quit
steps.purpose: QUIT GAME is the LAST row and the pause menu wraps: UP once from RESUME reaches it (lane E L-c: the 9-row pause menu keeps QUIT GAME last).

steps.name: quit
steps.purpose: QUIT GAME -> the two-choice popup (lane E L-c, srpause.aptasm ShowQuit; the game's own WARNING title and body) through FlowMgr.ShowGenPop: its own screen request (fresh: earlier requests of the path do not count).

steps.name: yes-quit
steps.purpose: A on the default QUIT TO TITLE (lane E L-c) -> StateAdapter.QuitGame, the game's own quit -> the game's own return to the front end: the title screen's own request again (roll quit_verify/discover_natural1: seen=2 ~1 s after YES). Absent = quit signature A (no reload request).

steps.name: fe-reloaded
steps.purpose: ScrPressStart's InitGui ran on the reload (the mod's Install; saveFlow+16 still holds the first session's popup id).

steps.name: title-again
steps.purpose: Capture window: the title after QUIT GAME.

steps.name: start-again
steps.purpose: START on the reloaded title: the sign-in read (XAM_PROFILE #3) and the menu claim again.

steps.name: menu-again
steps.purpose: Capture window: the MAIN MENU after QUIT GAME.
